title: Dhak beats on the Thames! British Bengalis take Durga Puja to London's iconic river
summary_full: British Bengalis marked the fifth annual Durga Parade on the River Thames in London this Saturday. The event featured a decorated idol of Goddess Durga sailing past famous landmarks like Big Ben and the London Eye. Musical performances and dancing were part of the celebrations aboard the boat, showcasing local talent. Bihar Tourism Minister Kedar Prasad Gupta attended and invited Indians to visit Bihar.
